title: China Plans $3.9T Grid Buildout to Turn Wasted Power Into AI Edge
summary:
Beijing intends to capture the approximately 9% of renewable energy output that was wasted in 2026 to fuel its computing infrastructure goals. The government is planning a $3.9T grid buildout through 2049 to transport surplus wind and solar power from the hinterlands to AI data centers, repurposing domestic energy gluts into a strategic advantage in artificial intelligence.

China currently has 24 GW of operational compute capacity with another 50 GW planned or under construction, compared to 56 GW operational in the US. This expansion is concentrated in energy-rich regions such as Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia, where 15 GW of capacity is planned, as China seeks to become the pre-eminent tech superpower.
